findings.title: run_config.json lacks run provenance bundle
findings.problem: Single-test run_config records test_names, technique, overrides, jobs, run_id, backup/teardown flags, and rag_api_url but does not capture git commit, dirty flag, kubectl context, Kubernetes server version, fixture digest, or a stable run UUID for cross-artifact joins.
findings.evidence:
run_config = {
        "test_names": [test_name],
        "technique": technique,
        "overrides": overrides,
        "jobs": 1,
        "run_id": run_id,
        "backup_before_run": backup_before_run,
        "teardown_after_run": teardown_after_run,
        "rag_api_url": rag_api_url,
    }
findings.suggestion: Extend run_config (or add provenance.json) written in cmd_run_single/cmd_run_many: capture subprocess output of git rev-parse HEAD, optional git status --porcelain, kubectl config current-context, kubectl version -o json (server block), ground_truth.schema.json version hash, and a uuid4 run_uuid reused in summary.json and metrics.
findings.impact: Published benchmark numbers cannot be reproduced or fairly compared across machines, cluster versions, or harness revisions.

findings.title: SQLite metrics rows cannot be joined to a specific RUN_DIR
findings.problem: The metrics table stores timestamp, test_case, model, agent_type, tokens, and costs but has no run_id/run_uuid column, so rows in token_metrics.db cannot be deterministically linked to `.local/test_runs/<run_id>/` artifacts.
findings.evidence:
cursor.execute('''
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metrics (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                test_case TEXT NOT NULL,
                model TEXT,
                agent_type TEXT,
                input_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                output_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                task_status INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                task_status_verified  INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                duration_s REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
                cost REAL DEFAULT 0.0
            )
        ''')
findings.suggestion: Add nullable columns run_uuid TEXT and run_id TEXT (or a single run_uuid) populated from executor at test start; migrate existing DBs with ALTER TABLE or versioned schema.
findings.impact: Cost and token history cannot be audited alongside per-test logs and ground_truth.json for a given harness execution.

findings.title: token_metrics.db lives at repo root, not under run output tree
findings.problem: Metrics are written to a single shared database path beside the repo root, which splits the audit trail across `.local/test_runs/` and an unrelated file with no enforced foreign key to run directories.
findings.suggestion: Either embed run_uuid in every insert and document the join contract, or optionally mirror metrics JSON per test under the run log_dir; keep DB as aggregate only with explicit schema documentation.
findings.impact: Operators analyzing only run folders miss token/cost data; DB-only analysis misses GT and verification artifacts.

findings.title: Verification agent full report is never persisted as a run artifact
findings.problem: The verification LLM response is stored on the agent object (verificationReport) and used for token metrics, but the runner does not write an equivalent of ground_truth.json for the middle layer of the verification hierarchy.
findings.suggestion: After verification, write verification_report.txt (or .json with redaction options) under the test log_dir alongside summary.json; include parsed status and raw text hash for large payloads.
findings.impact: Cannot mine verification vs ground-truth disagreement or audit UNKNOWN token cases without re-running the model.

findings.title: ground_truth.json has no schema or harness version field
findings.problem: GroundTruthResult.to_dict serializes test_name, passed, checks, summary, duration, and timestamp but omits ground_truth.schema.json version or repo revision, so old runs cannot be interpreted after schema evolution.
findings.suggestion: Add optional fields ground_truth_schema_version and schema_hash (from GROUND_TRUTH_SCHEMA_PATH content) when saving via save_ground_truth_result.
findings.impact: Longitudinal benchmark comparisons may mis-attribute PASS/FAIL changes to the model when the schema or check semantics changed.

findings.title: Run comparison omits self-report vs verifier and run provenance
findings.problem: Per-test comparison rows include status, verified, ground_truth_passed, tokens, cost, and duration but not debug_self_report, so the three-layer hierarchy from benchmark philosophy is collapsed in compare output; aggregate comparison also ignores harness versions.
findings.evidence:
return {
        "status": summary.status,
        "verified": summary.verified,
        "ground_truth_passed": summary.ground_truth_passed,
        "debug_tokens": dbg_tok,
        "verification_tokens": ver_tok,
        "total_tokens": dbg_tok + ver_tok,
        "debug_cost": round(_num(dbg, "cost"), 4),
        "verification_cost": round(_num(ver, "cost"), 4),
        "total_cost": round(_num(dbg, "cost") + _num(ver, "cost"), 4),
        "duration_s": round(float(summary.duration_s or 0), 2),
    }
findings.suggestion: Extend _summary_row with debug_self_report from TestSummary; load optional provenance.json from each run root if present and print a short harness diff section in compare_runs_markdown.
findings.impact: Cross-run analysis hides overclaim (SOLVED vs GT FAIL) and makes A/B model studies harder to interpret.

findings.title: RAG responses are not persisted for retrieval audit
findings.problem: ask_question posts to /ask/ and returns JSON from the API, but nothing in this module or AgentAPI persists chunk IDs, scores, or hashes for post-hoc shortcut or contamination analysis.
findings.suggestion: If the API returns source metadata, capture it in the runner and write rag_retrieval.json per test (query hash, doc ids, chunk hashes); if not, extend the API contract and thread optional logging through AgentAPI.askQuestion.
findings.impact: Cannot verify whether the knowledge phase leaked fix-adjacent content or dominated the measured task.

findings.title: TestSummary omits platform and cluster context
findings.problem: The canonical summary.json schema has no fields for sys.platform, shell flavor, kubectl context, or Python version, so environment-driven capability differences are not recorded beside PASS/FAIL.
findings.evidence:
@dataclass
class TestSummary:
    """Summary of a single test execution."""
    test_name: str
    technique: str
    status: str  # PASS, FAIL, ERROR, TIMEOUT
    verified: Optional[bool]  # True/False if verification ran, None if no verification
    debug_self_report: Optional[bool] = None
findings.suggestion: Add optional dict environment_context or top-level fields populated once per test in result_to_summary: platform, python version, kubectl context (best-effort subprocess), minikube profile from config.
findings.impact: Windows vs Unix or cluster skew cannot be stratified when publishing aggregate pass rates.

findings.title: queue_summary.json lacks stochastic reporting metadata
findings.problem: Repeat queue summary records iteration index, status, duration, and output_dir but not model IDs, seeds, temperature, or aggregation hints needed for credible multi-run statistics.
findings.evidence:
summary_obj = {
        "queue_id": base_run_id,
        "total_iterations": total,
        "completed_iterations": len(results),
        "stall_limit_s": stall_limit,
        "started_at": queue_started_at,
        "finished_at": queue_finished_at,
        "results": [],
    }
findings.suggestion: Embed effective CLI overrides snapshot per iteration (or pointer to each iter's run_config.json), document median/IQR reporting in docs, and add optional seed field when APIs support it.
findings.impact: Repeat queues produce folders but no machine-readable standard for publishing pass@k or variance.

findings.title: run_config omits RAG server api_version and repo_signature
findings.problem: run_config stores rag_api_url only. The client validates api_version and repo_signature during requests (rag_api._ensure_server_compatible) but those values are not frozen into the run bundle, so later analysis cannot tell which server build served retrieval.
findings.suggestion: After successful preflight or first RAG call, capture server_info (api_version, repo_signature) into run_config or provenance.json.
findings.impact: Changing RAG server or corpus between runs breaks comparability without a recorded fingerprint.
